summary: This report walks through investigating a suspicious Microsoft Teams message sent by an Entra Agent ID agent user, correlating Purview MicrosoftTeams MessageCreatedHasLink events with MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs and AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs via AppAccessContext.UniqueTokenId. Agent users never produce interactive sign-ins; their activity is identifiable through the Agent.agentSubjectType value agentIDuser and the linked agent identity/blueprint in non-interactive sign-in logs. The agent-user OAuth flow (blueprint client secret, AzureADTokenExchange client assertion, user_fic on-behalf-of exchange) and the Graph API POST to a team channel messages endpoint are the key behaviors to detect.
